items.text: In 1932, the Australian Army sent soldiers armed with Lewis machine guns to cull emus that were damaging wheat farms in Western Australia.
items.notes: Tricky truth: sounds invented, is well sourced.

items.text: In 1859, Sweden held a national lottery whose grand prize was a working lighthouse, and it was won by a farmer who had never seen the sea.
items.notes: Fully invented lie built from real texture.

items.text: The Anglo-Zanzibar War of 1896 lasted somewhere between 8 and 12 hours, making it one of the shortest recorded wars in history.
items.notes: Near-miss: a one-detail edit of a real fact. The generator must never write these; the judge must catch them.
